title: Shared document lifecycle
summary: The channel-neutral lifecycle both TUI and web should use to prepare, expose, degrade, recover, and release a document context.
implementationStatus: Backend preparation exists; shared reader/release behavior and frontend adoption remain incomplete.
tuiDesign: Drive long-running work through commands and explicit result states rather than hidden constructor I/O.
webDesign: Represent lifecycle outcomes as accessible route states while keeping parsing, identity, validation, and policy in shared application services.
